extractions.justification: The task involved identifying acronyms and abbreviations from the given list of expressions. Each term was carefully examined to determine if it contained an acronym or abbreviation. Expressions with at least one acronym or abbreviation were paired with their full forms if available within the same list. For example, 'ar' is present as an expression but its full form wasn't found in the list, so the full_form field is empty. Similarly, for each identified acronym or abbreviation, a check was made to see if its full form exists elsewhere in the provided expressions. For instance, 'compbio' corresponds to 'computational biology', so these were paired together. Terms without any acronyms or abbreviations were moved to the others list. In cases where an acronym or abbreviation had no matching full form within the given expressions, only the acronym/abbreviation was noted in the acronyms_abbreviations list with an empty string for the full_form field.
